subject: op-spd
title: OP.SPD.------POL.P.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 469 (MP(I)-43). OP-SPD (option spread) is the subject; POL-P (political policies) is the partner. From the subject: PART-2 (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", C-INFO (composite information) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PART-2: AFN (affinity negation). From C-INFO: PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PROG-CONT: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From AFN: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From PART: JR-DY (journalism dynamics). From CULT-AF-BS: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics).
